The '''Rindia system''' was located in the [[Nembus sector/Legends|Nembus sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was home to the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] known as [[Rindian]]s.<ref name="JA" /><ref name="Planetnamia" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Rindia [[Star system/Legends|system]] was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square P-4.<ref name="TEA" />
